Interface LegacyQueryService

All Known Subinterfaces:
QueryService
All Known Implementing Classes:
QuerySvc
@Deprecated public interface LegacyQueryService
Deprecated.
Use QueryService directly.
Keeps the old Future<?> execute(String, ThrowingConsumer) signature in the bytecode.

Extensions compiled before QueryService.execute(String, QueryService.ThrowingConsumer) returned CompletableFuture<Void> still call the old descriptor and would otherwise fail with NoSuchMethodError. The covariant override in QueryService makes javac emit the bridge.
